maya: Heads up — noticed ~72k in untagged GPU spend in us-west1 for March. Looks like reserved capacity billing line-items have no cost-center tags. Anyone else seeing this?
ravi: Saw the billing alert this morning. @finance-ops flagged it. Could be autoscaler creating short-lived instances without labels.
jonah: How are we mapping reservations to instances today? Reserved SKUs vs instance labels have been fragile historically.
maya: Quick query I ran against billing export — shows invoice items where resource.labels is null but sku contains 'Committed Use' and 'A100'. Paste SQL below.
```sql
SELECT invoice_month, sku_description, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `company-billing.gcp.billing_export`
WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(sku_description, r'GPU|Committed|A100')
  AND project = 'redwood-inference-prod'
  AND resource.labels.cost_center IS NULL
GROUP BY invoice_month, sku_description
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
ravi: Oof. That matches the alert. Also check compute instances for missing labels with a simple gcloud check:
```bash
gcloud compute instances list --filter="NOT labels.cost-center:*" --format="table(name,zone,status,labels)"
```
sam: Quick idea — if reserved capacity lives in a different project or dedicated pool, but instances are launched in shared projects (or via node pools), labels might not carry across. Check node pool instance templates and startup scripts.
jonah: I can run an inventory of node pools and their instance templates. Also: can we retroactively allocate those invoice line items to cost-centers via internal mapping? @finance-ops
finance-ops: We can't change the cloud invoices themselves, but we can create an internal reallocation mapping and reflect it in our internal chargeback reports. Need a deterministic mapping strategy.
billing-bot: alert: untagged compute GPUs detected — amount: $72,193. See /billing/alerts/1850045678
maya: Proposed action plan:
1) Backfill internal cost allocation mapping (SQL + heuristics) — owner: jonah
2) Patch autoscaler & IaC to enforce labels on instance creation — owner: ravi
3) Create billing alert for reserved vs instance tag mismatch — owner: maya
4) Short-term manual chargeback for impacted teams (internal accounting) — owner: finance-ops
5) Review reserved commitment sizing and capacity assignment for us-west1 — owner: infra-leads
ravi: For enforcement, add label plumbing into our instance templates and terraform modules. Example snippet: 
```hcl
resource "google_compute_instance_template" "gpu" {
  labels = merge(var.labels, { "cost-center" = var.cost_center })
  # ...
}
```
sam: Also recommend adding an audit log filter rule to detect instances launched without labels: `protoPayload.methodName="v1.compute.instances.insert" AND NOT resource.labels.cost_center:*`
jonah: I'll produce the backfill mapping today. Plan: join billing export with reservations usage; match on SKU, region (us-west1), and timestamp windows. If ambiguous, allocate proportionally to recent usage per team.
maya: Timeline — backfill report by EOD tomorrow. Policy PR for terraform by Friday. Can someone own the chargeback notice to product teams?
finance-ops: I'll draft a short internal note outlining the reallocation methodology and a chargeback spreadsheet. This will be internal accounting only — we won't change invoices.
maya: A couple follow-ups: 1) Are there legacy dedicated pools in us-west1 created by older scripts? 2) Any autoscaler that scales into a different project?
ravi: Yes — found one legacy pool `dedicated-ai-west-legacy` created 2022-09-10. I'll inventory and tag it.
sam: Creating an SRE alert rule `CREATE-RESERVED-TAG-MISMATCH` to emit to #eng-infra and page if > $5k/day.
jonah: Uploading mapping SQL for transparency: 
```sql
WITH gpu_billing AS (
  SELECT invoice_month, sku_description, region, SUM(cost) cost
  FROM `company-billing.gcp.billing_export`
  WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(sku_description, r'GPU|A100') AND resource.labels.cost_center IS NULL
  GROUP BY invoice_month, sku_description, region
)
SELECT b.*, r.project, r.node_pool, r.team
FROM gpu_billing b
LEFT JOIN `infra_metadata.reservations` r
  ON b.region = r.region AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(b.sku_description, r.gpu_sku_match)
ORDER BY b.cost DESC;
```
maya: Thanks everyone. Tagging the infra PRs as critical. :exclamation: Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am to review backfill numbers and the chargeback spreadsheet.
sam: Noted — adding the 10:00 slot to eng-infra calendar.
finance-ops: Received. We'll prepare the chargeback templates and send a heads-up to product teams after internal review.
billing-bot: note: created ticket BILL-1850045678 in billing tracker.
